meta.home_description: HoldMyTrack is a free, community-funded place to see every outdoor activity you have ever recorded on one map — Fog of War, heatmaps and routes from your watch, phone or old exports. Free for everyone, and your data is never sold.

settings.onboarding_intro: Two things before your map: your country sets whether distances show in km or miles, and your timezone sets which day each activity falls on. You can change both here later.

settings.timezone_hint: Decides which calendar day an activity falls on everywhere in the app (the histogram, the activity graph, date filtering). Auto-detected from your browser when you signed up; change it here if you're somewhere else now.
settings.theme_hint: In this browser only. Applies at once.
settings.export_hint: A copy of everything in your account, as zip archives: the files you uploaded or synced, every activity as GPX, your photos, and your settings, Stories, Private locations and captured places (what's inside).

settings.delete_hint: Deletes your account and everything in it, for good: every activity and the files you uploaded, your photos, Stories, Private locations and captured places. You're signed out everywhere at once. It can't be undone, and backups keep it for up to 8 weeks (privacy policy).

email.export.subject: Your HoldMyTrack data is ready to download
export.readme:
Your HoldMyTrack data, as of {date}

If this download came in several zip archives, extract them all into the same folder: together they make one set of folders.

originals/  Every file you uploaded or synced, exactly as it arrived (GPX, FIT, TCX, or JSON for activities synced from a phone). These are complete: Private locations haven't been applied to them.
tracks/     Every activity as a GPX file, as your map shows it: with your Private locations cut away and your track edits applied.
photos/     The copy of each photo you added, as HoldMyTrack keeps it.
account.json  Your account and settings, every activity's details and which files are its, your Stories, Private locations and captured places.

HoldMyTrack keeps no health data, so there is none here.

sync.title: Sync history
sync.subtext: Everything you've imported, once it's finished: files you uploaded and activities synced from your phone, newest first. An activity recorded twice — by your watch and your phone, say — is a Duplicate: only the fuller copy is kept on the map. What's still being processed is in the Upload menu.
sync.demo: The demo account's imports. Create an account to import your own.
sync.empty: Nothing imported yet. Upload files from the header, or sync from the Android app.
upload.label: Upload
upload.demo: Not available for demo accounts — create an account to upload your own activities
upload.hint: .gpx, .fit, .tcx, a .zip of them, a Google Health export or a Google Maps Timeline .json — or drop them on the map
upload.timeline_one: A Google Maps Timeline export imports one at a time: only the first was opened.
upload.timeline_alone: A Google Maps Timeline export imports on its own: choose the other files again once it's done.
upload.idle: Nothing is being imported right now.
upload.too_many: Too many files selected ({n}) — zip them and upload the archive instead.
upload.truncated: {filename} had more files than can be processed at once; the rest weren't read.
ingest_error.unsupported_format: This file type isn't supported (want .gpx, .fit or .tcx).
ingest_error.unreadable_file: The file couldn't be read. It may be damaged, or not the format its name says.
ingest_error.no_track: The file has no GPS points. It may be from an indoor workout.
ingest_error.too_few_points: The file has fewer than two GPS points, so there's no track to draw.
ingest_error.no_timestamps: The file has no timestamps. It's a planned route, not a recorded activity.
ingest_error.too_large: The track covers too much ground to draw: more than 20,000 map squares of about 2.4 km.
ingest_error.internal: Something went wrong on our side while processing it.
unpack_error.internal: Something went wrong on our side while unpacking it.
